folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B213, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All U01–U20, U16a–c, U18a–e and C1–C5 were reviewed. Keep useful bounded tests: held batch continuity versus independent crafting, origin-qualified key versus lookalike/custody, specific modified copy versus generic rarity, supported absence versus a derived XP estimate, tool function versus possession, retained gift versus continuing institution service, live song versus constructed ward, and follower consent versus inherited estate. Different leaves stay independent; one stance or one nested return does not close all proposed behavior. B212 qualifies the parent ledger’s generic source joins and repeated representations; it supplies no new runtime evidence (AD32/AD36).

U14’s “cannot generate free money” wording is a proposed local shaping fixture, not a general ban on profitable transformation, trade or a world-supported material source. State actual source, quantity, value, recipient and consumer under the selected mechanism; no universal conservation tax or forced opposite-affinity loss follows. Likewise U17’s two-unmet-needs threshold and excluded arbitrary JavaScript describe its proposed parser slice, not new universal design authority or anti-cheat rules. AD51 permits a seam for a concrete known consumer, with a different world validating reuse; AD22 keeps solo-play freedom subject to save integrity.

The common 1440-primary/1366 fit wording is historical; selected current UI work follows current desktop targets and prose-first task composition. SourceReady false in U01/U03/U04/U11/U15 remains an exact upstream reading gap for that proposed absorption, not an embargo on independent current functionality. Existing consumer evidence, including later Foundation method use, must be compared against the actual candidate before building another path. AD52 allows supported compression and long play; earned convenience need not become a compulsory chore. No historical packet launches workers, creates a worktree, changes a priority, grants a commit, or requires renewed human taste approval as a blocker under AD42. No code, primary source or runtime proof was refreshed in B213.

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.
